notes.title: Update on Just Life's Progress: We're Still Hard at Work!
notes.notes:
Hello, I want to share an update to let you know that we are still working hard. Unfortunately, the Kickstarter campaign did not reach its goals, but that doesn't stop us. We are continuing our efforts on Just Life, and we are excited to showcase new screenshots of the game.
